name: W.W. Grainger, Inc.

Technology acquisition completed (integration costs in Q4 2026 guidance); target not named in source
Q3 2026 results; guidance raised; interim CFO in place (Laurie Thomson)

geography.fx_notes: ESTIMATE: US-dominated (>80%); MonotaRO Japan ~13-14% of sales; Canada/Mexico small. UK exited 2025. JPY translation affects reported growth (yen depreciation cited Q3 2026).

kpis.value: HTS +13.8%; EA +19.3% daily organic cc; Zoro US +25.2%; MonotaRO +13.6% local

lease.source_id: US GAAP filer; operating lease cost in SG&A

acquisitions.notes: Technology acquisition completed Aug-2026 (size not disclosed in source). Historically organic grower; UK disposal 2025.

management.cfo: Laurie Thomson (VP, Controller and Interim CFO)
management.senior_turnover_5y: CFO seat vacant/interim in Q3 2026 (permanent CFO departure; details not retrieved)
management.succession_notes: CEO tenure ~10 years; no announced CEO succession in sources reviewed
management.guidance_record: Good: 2026 guide raised to 13-14.5% daily organic cc growth and 16-16.2% op. margin

ownership.controlling_holders: None; widely held. Note MonotaRO is a ~50%-owned listed Japanese subsidiary (minority interest)

guidance.item: FY2026 daily organic cc sales growth

evidence: MRO small-ticket repeat purchases across ~millions of SKUs
All major end markets up y/y [S1]
Inventory management services for large customers
A.rationale: Repeat MRO consumables with broad customer base; cyclical volume.

evidence: HTS margin 17.3% above most MRO peers [S1]
Proprietary data/catalogue and supplier rebates scale
B.rationale: Scale, availability and service create durable advantage in fragmented MRO.

evidence: Largest US MRO distributor; HTS op margin 17.3% [S1]
C.rationale: Scale produces measurably superior margins vs MSM/AIT peers.

D.rationale: Healthy runway via share gains and online model.

evidence: Interim CFO in 2026 is a modest stability flag
Organic reinvestment, UK exit of sub-par business [S1]
Endless Assortment is online and price-transparent [S1]
I1.rationale: Moderate disintermediation risk in online catalogue MRO.

evidence: Data-centre exposed growth in retail/commercial services/contractor end markets [S1]
I2.rationale: INFERENCE: data-centre-related demand probably 2-5% of sales.

evidence: Large customer-service and sales SG&A base

I4.rationale: Position allows retention of much of the savings.

evidence: Inventory write-off from DC fire disclosed [S1]

ai.notes: Data-centre-exposed customers cited as growth driver, not quantified; INFERENCE 2-5%.

sector_specific.notes: Contractor end market exists (share not disclosed in source). Acquisition growth ~0 (organic model). Small-ticket MRO; GM ~39%.

gates.notes: Low leverage; cash conversion historically high (verify centrally); no customer >15%; AI/DC <15% inferred; US domicile.

bull_points: 2026 organic growth guide 13-14.5% with op margin up 100-120bp (S1)
Endless Assortment (Zoro, MonotaRO) scaling with rising margins (S1)
Exit of sub-scale UK improves returns (S1)
bear_points: 2026 growth flattered by data-centre and project spend and lapping 2025 government shutdown; normalisation expected (S1)
Online MRO is price-transparent and contested by Amazon Business (INFERENCE)
CFO transition (interim CFO) in a peak-margin year (S1)
thesis_breakers: HTS operating margin below 15% for a full year
Daily organic cc growth below US MRO market growth for 4 quarters
Endless Assortment margin falling back below 9%
